ctx.x: I remember one time playing with, it was like top musicians, except for myself. I was the young one. It was Manny Duran who played with the Machito orchestra, Eddie Martinez who played with Chico O’Farrill, everybody Gato Barbieri, Patato on congas. The bass player was Victor Menenguez a veteran from the scene. We were playing. Midway the coordinator stopped us, paid us, sent us home, they put a boom box in the middle of the room and people again just started dancing. So they didn’t even appreciate the Latino…
Let’s suppose you went to a party and someone asks you what you do and, “Well I play a lot of Latin jazz.” And that person said, “What makes Latin jazz different from jazz?”
